answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents for audit: the agent must show an opal-stamped receipt for verified work, a signed mesa of done jobs, and a pulse check proving it is active. Failing freezes the identity and burns its 40-unit bond. 100 fakes cost 100 x 40 = 4,000 in bonds, while each fake earns about 30 per epoch, so break-even takes 133 epochs. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps full rewards.
